name: tg-payroll-social
description: Togo payroll and social contribution reference for the 2026 tax year, covering private employees, employer withholding, the general CNSS regime and compulsory health insurance under AMU. Use it for IRPP payroll, salary contributions, pension, prestations familiales, risques professionnels, assurance maladie universelle, ADC and DAS. It separates the employee withholding base from the CNSS and AMU contribution bases, records the ordinary employer and employee allocations and their deadlines, and links the annual income tax calculation to the personal income tax Guide. Independent, informal and voluntary CNSS categories are identified separately. The Guide also records unresolved current wage floor evidence, declaration interfaces and nonemployee health contributions rather than extending employee percentages to everyone.
